```python
rgb = bot.rgbd('right')['rgb']
yy, xx = np.indices(rgb.shape[:2])
vertices = np.array([[286, 188], [331, 166], [366, 190], [359, 224], [320, 247], [286, 220]])
mask = np.ones(rgb.shape[:2], dtype=bool)
for a, b in zip(vertices, np.roll(vertices, -1, axis=0)):
    mask &= (b[0] - a[0]) * (yy - a[1]) - (b[1] - a[1]) * (xx - a[0]) >= 0
purple = bot.localize_object('purple block', mask, camera='right', arm='right')
source_top = bot.measure_depth(331, 187, camera='right', arm='right')
source_table = bot.measure_depth(375, 233, camera='right', arm='right')
destination_top = bot.measure_depth(425, 280, camera='right', arm='right')
print({'purple': purple, 'source_top': source_top, 'source_table': source_table, 'destination_top': destination_top})
```
